name: finesse
description: Finesse campus finance management: React web app + React Native app + Express API on a shared Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime) project

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix web
